name: shared-observed-quadratic-head-v1
lean_audit: 5570b115; CD8 complete head, CM42 arbitrary fixed rows and CM51 normalized bounds
input: Original ordered record IDs and raw labels, ordinal token domain, and the entire source block route derived from the frozen training-only parent. Bind parent and source hashes; no task names, generators or heldout data.
features: Last two tokens centered in[-1,1]; [1,u,v,u*u,u*v,v*v,0,0] normalized by max(1,sum(abs)); complete unitary8-state Fourier transform in the fixed source block. Observed rows use the same features as queries.
head: Every real/imaginary coefficient and raw class learns freely. One global per-class L1 ball of radius65536 across all blocks. Ordinary full-vocabulary CE on actual complex products; no separately learned routing factor.
initialization: Single class: constant192. Two classes: inspect all16 fixed ordinal directions, retain every gap and choose greatest positive separation gap with first-index ties; threshold is the observed interclass midpoint, minimum normalized pair margin4. If no separator or more classes, use explicit regularized quadratic class moments with covariance ridge0.01. Absent classes have zero scores. Common bias makes every observed class score at least192 before normalization on the input square. Empty blocks are zero. Project the entire head afterward and report actual initial CE.
selection: No validation selection and no restoring old observed logits. Report final iterate, every step and epoch CE, even when worse. Initialization/search is exposed separately from CE gradients and updates.
inspection: Externally verify the complete parent SHA256 before parsing its fixed parent/context chain. Extract only the complete source and original record IDs; retain all source-head bytes in its hash. Charge32 times parent file bytes plus1GiB for parsing, plus the native training buffer forecast. Save the prospective forecast before fitting, then reconstruct the complete saved outcome exactly. No original heldout evaluation.
scope: Native component and synthetic/training-only checks first. All35 scoring is task330. No unseen-label, native-refinement or convergence certificate. Flatness is a feature/logit bound.
